name: Infinipaint
blurb: InfiniPaint is a collaborative, infinite space, infinite zoom, canvas note-taking/drawing app.
description:
InfiniPaint is a collaborative, infinite space, infinite zoom, canvas note-taking/drawing app. Unlike many other infinite canvas apps, there is no zoom in or zoom out limit. This means that this app is very good at things such as drawing sketches of the solar system to scale, or just drawing any massive objects with tiny details. Of course, this app is also perfectly well suited for use as a normal canvas.

Features:

• Infinite canvas, with infinite zoom

• Open online lobbies for collaboration

• Graphics tablet support (Pressure sensitive brush and eraser detection)

• Layers with blend modes

• Saveable color palettes

• Right click to open a quick menu

• Place bookmarks on the canvas to jump to later

• Undo/Redo

• Screenshot to export parts of the canvas to a picture (can export to raster formats or SVG)

• Place text boxes with formatting

• Other tools such as: Rectangle select tool, Lasso select tool, Color picker tool, Grid tool, Rectangle tool, Ellipse tool, Line tool

• Copy and paste objects on the canvas, and between different canvases

• Insert images and files on the canvas

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
